title: [IELTS Trainer] - Manufacture of frozen fish pies
prompt: The diagrams below give information about the manufacture of frozen fish pies. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagrams illustrate the process of manufacturing frozen fish pies.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the production consists of multiple interconnected stages, beginning with the preparation of raw ingredients and ending with the freezing, storage, and final distribution of the finished product. Both potatoes and salmon are prepared separately in distinct processing lines before their ingredients are ultimately combined to create ready-to-eat pies for retail sale.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: At the initial stage, potatoes are delivered to the factory, where they are thoroughly cleaned, peeled, and sliced into smaller pieces suitable for cooking. These slices are then boiled, chilled, and carefully stored until required for later use. Meanwhile, fresh salmon is transported to the facility and must be processed within 12 hours of delivery to preserve its freshness. It is then cooked in a steam oven, after which the skin and bones are removed and discarded. In the next step, the remaining flesh is meticulously inspected to ensure that only high-quality portions are selected for the following phase.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Following those preparatory stages, the prepared salmon will be mixed with peas, sauce, and the previously stored potatoes in microwaveable containers, which are sealed to create individual portions. After assembly, each pie is wrapped, labeled, and frozen at controlled temperatures to maintain its flavor and texture. Finally, the finished products are transferred to cold storage units, kept there until dispatch, and then delivered to retailers for public sale.
